head: 172ab8bb4404167945475c0673b2572c26a2ba3d
summary:
SL-112 (build commit 172ab8b; the tree is clean apart from .taad/slices) does what the design says. It adds one watermark to ScanStore. EndSizeChecks refuses values outside 0..Count, and Scanner.Run.Finish writes it as its first statement: Count when the scan Completed, otherwise _uncheckedFrom, which is entries[0] of the batch SizeBatch saw come back Cancelled and 0 when no batch was cancelled. SizeFiles has no other `return false` today, so the cutoff is right on every path that exists. Three reads come from the watermark: SizeCheckPending, Unfinished and AtLeast. PendingRun walks the folder's preorder range by the chain of last folders that have children, reading each entry's own page. It is correct for the DFS registration with one SetChildren per block, and it terminates because each step goes down to a child folder. The 'sized from the file itself' rule has one copy, in EntryRules; SizeProbe.IsEligible delegates to it, and grep finds no other copy in src. StoppedInSizeChecks (Cancelled && _uncheckedFrom > 0) is carried as an init property and picks the sizing arm of ListHeader. Both header strings match the m1 disposition. The builder declared every deviation: EntryRules, the m1 wording, Tally.Bound at 15 s, and the BOM.

What I ran:
- Build, then the full suite with TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp: 1096 passed, 0 failed.
- `git diff --diff-filter=MD 4df2b1c 172ab8b -- tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests` is empty, so no existing test was edited.
- Fitness check: 100 rules, all hold.
- WindowCases L-004 (Stop at sized=0 of 60,000; header is the sizing string; 30 rows, none marked) and L-001 (new listing string) both PASSED with a fresh publish. No L004-* root was left behind.

Four mutations, each restored afterwards (`git status src` clean):
- Dropping `ChildCount > 0` from PendingRun's chain walk: 4 UnfinishedTests went red, the synthetic-shapes Fact among them, so the shape 'last subfolder empty or unlisted after a non-empty sibling' is really fed.
- Reading the block walk from one page: the synthetic Fact hung on the >65,536-child straddle store (so the shape is fed). I killed my own testhost.
- Putting the cutoff one batch late: both sizing rows and the stuck-worker Fact went red.
- Writing watermark 0 for a Completed scan: 5 of 6 went red.

The real-tree oracle reads only flags and Parent chains, never the watermark. It checks every entry and compares every folder with two uninterrupted references, with teeth and non-vacuity floors. The three reads have no caller in src outside the store yet. The design files that wiring to SC-393, and NotListedAtOrBelow is in the same state, so it is not a finding. Not re-run by me: WindowMutants -Mutant All (Q-114, validate's job) and the rules harness and RuleCases (I only checked that the S87/P37 plant rows exist). The stalled-share network pass is still a person's run (lesson #136).

Second round: Second round, read as someone trying to break the code: nothing new to file.

- **The range walk (ScanStore.PendingRun):** the end comes from the chain of last folders that have children. It works on stores where the walk ends with an empty or unlisted subfolder, and on the excluded store, whose SetChildren(Count, 0) leaves FirstChild -1. A block that straddles two pages is read entry by entry from each entry's own page. The start is the later of the watermark and the folder's FirstChild. On a well-formed tree every step goes down to a child folder, so the walk ends; it would loop only if a page were read wrongly, which my first-round mutant forced.
- **AtLeast:** every file it subtracts (ChecksOwnSize) is one that is charged, so the result is never negative. For a file and for a link it matches RolledSize and FilesBelow (1 for a file, 0 for a link, ScanStore.Rollup.cs:39-47). Indices are 0-based on both sides, with the root at 0.
- **What the callers can pass:** EndSizeChecks rejects anything outside 0..Count. In Finish its argument is Count, 0, or entries[0] (always ≥ 1 and < Count), so it cannot throw on the Stop path. ProbePass.Run returns Cancelled on every non-success path (ProbePass.cs:72, 95, 102), and SizeFiles has no other way to return false. So StoppedInSizeChecks cannot be false after some checks were applied.
- **The header:** `init` on a class with an internal constructor cannot be set outside Core. No hook C#, tests/bugs project or Core test pins the old header text; I grepped every *.cs under tests.
- **Window case L-004:** `Field $acted 'sized'` may pick up `atsized=`, but the check only needs a number, so the outcome is the same.
- **Fitness rule `\bEndSizeChecks\b`:** `@EndSizeChecks` and `nameof(...)` match it. A `S` escape inside the identifier, or a reflection string built in pieces, would get past it. The design record already states the rule guards one spelling only, not the whole family (docs/design/SL-112-unfinished-at-stop.md:154, lesson #486), so filing that would only pad the review.

Q-111 picked the header wording, and that error paths outside an unchanged tree (a probe refused only on one run, a file that vanishes) count as checked was settled under case C-008; neither is reopened here.

obligations.evidence: By reading: Finish (Scanner.cs:581-610) writes the watermark first, and nothing after it writes the store; abandoned ProbePass workers write only their batch's readings array, which is never applied (ProbePass.cs:93-95 sets _abandoned and returns Cancelled; SizeBatch applies nothing then). By test: UnfinishedTests.NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned / StuckStop (UnfinishedTests.cs:798-844) dumps every column and all three reads at the return and after the stuck worker leaves, and finds 0 differences. Green in my full-suite run. The store is not sealed (m3 was waived to SC-408), so this holds for today's writers only.

UnfinishedTests.cs:51-122: Stops after every AfterFolder n=1..FoldersListed (the last included); sampled guarded calls 1-6 plus every 7th, before and during; every call of the 'wide' folder (asserted to span more than 4 calls); Cancel at 10 entries of a commit. EmptyStores >= 2 is asserted. Check() asserts StoppedInSizeChecks == false and compares the oracle entry by entry.

UnfinishedTests.cs:146-166: Cancel from the ProbeRule seam on the scan thread while it builds the batch, for k in {1,2,7,8,9,16,17,24,25,...}, workers 1 and 4, ProbeBatch 8. `prober.Calls == ordinal` proves the Cancelled batch started no probe. My one-batch-late mutation turned it red.

UnfinishedTests.cs:169-188: Cancel in the Prober's Before/After hooks at 14 call numbers; asserts prober.Calls > ordinal (a probe was made in the discarded batch) and that the landing ordinal is a whole number of batches.

StuckStop (UnfinishedTests.cs:798-844): the Before hook blocks on release.Wait(); ProbeAbandonAfter is 200 ms; Scan must return in under 5 s; Check pins the cutoff to the stuck batch; the dump at return equals the dump after release. With workers=1 every worker is stuck; with 4, one is.

StopTree grow groups A (ga→ga\sub), C (beside), E (ge1→ge2\sub), G (deep chain→gg) at UnfinishedTests.cs:407-413. Check :747-766 asserts that every ancestor of a pending first name is Unfinished and that each charged (HardlinkDuplicate) flag matches the reference by path (:724-725).
Shrink groups B, D, F. The floor ShrinkAboveWhileAtLeastHolds >= 1 is asserted in both sweeps (:119, :199), and AtLeast <= reference is asserted for every unfinished folder (:740-741).
Check :732-737 requires rolled == AtLeast == reference for every non-Unfinished folder; floors LaterNameFolderFinalFirstPending and CorrectedFirstFolderFinal >= 1 (:200-201).
The Prober returns error 5 for pf1\x.bin and pf2\y.bin (:504-508); Reference.Take asserts ProbeFailures == 2; floor RefusedCheckFolderFinal >= 1 (:202).

TheReadAnswersAsAParentWalkOnEveryScannerShapedStore (:304-342), with Synthetic and CheckEveryWatermark (:880-989): 140 random stores plus 3 with a 70,000-child block straddling the 65,536 page; watermarks 0, Count, random points and first-file edges; empty-store and EndSizeChecks bounds. Killed by my ChildCount>0 mutant; hung by my one-page mutant.

NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned (:215-246) runs the stuck-worker dumps for workers 1 and 4, and checks that the folder committed after Cancel reads listed with its checked-kind files pending (the m5 replacement).

AScanThatRunsToTheEndMarksNothing (:255-294) covers three trees: the StopTree run to the end, SweepTree with 5 files deleted (VanishedBeforeProbe == 5 asserted), and a folders-only tree (Probes == 0). CompletedMarksNothing also asserts StoppedInSizeChecks false. My watermark-0-on-Completed mutant turned it red.

`git diff --diff-filter=MD 4df2b1c 172ab8b -- tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests` is empty (only the two added files). The full suite passed 1096/1096 under TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, the counting-rule and last-access classes included.

UnfinishedBudgetTests.cs:36-237: two rows (watermark 0 at the unlisted peak; listed to the end with 97% checked). Asserts reads retain < 1 MiB, allocate 0 bytes, retained and peak < 800 MiB, 100k rows < 250 ms, then compares every entry with a Parent-column walk. Green in my run.

Test-L004 in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1: per-run GUID root under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, a VOID relaunch on Completed, removal with [IO.Directory]::Delete. I ran it: PASSED, acted at sized=0 of 60,000, header == $StoppedSizingHeader. L-001 PASSED with the new $StoppedListHeader.

MainWindow.xaml.cs:410-414 has the third arm and the new listing-Stop arm; WindowCases.ps1:6373-6375 updates $StoppedListHeader and adds $StoppedSizingHeader; Test-L001 reads the variable. The last-AfterFolder Stop is asserted StoppedInSizeChecks false (UnfinishedTests.cs:59-69).

Hardlinks are made once in the StopTree constructor (:397-406); Restale uses only FileStream.SetLength (:452-472); Tally.Bound is 15 s, asked at every Stop (:590-595). My UnfinishedTests runs took seconds.
Part (i) cancels from the ProbeRule seam on the scan thread, and asserts both prober.Calls == ordinal and landing.Ordinal == ordinal, so the floor counts landings (:146-166, :198).
The 200 ms listing comparison is gone; NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned :225-245 asserts the committed-after-Cancel folder is listed and its checked-kind children are pending.

eng/rules-harness/plants.json has S87 (new src/FsAnalyser.Core/Analysis file calling EndSizeChecks, fitness fire) and P37 (insert in Scanner.cs, quiet); .taad/fitness.yaml:1380-1392 has the settled rule with except_files ScanStore.cs and Scanner.cs. Fitness check: 100 rules hold. I did not re-run harness.py or RuleCases; the builder's record says 169/169 and C-001/C-003 held.
docs/design/SL-112-unfinished-at-stop.md:103-107 cites storeBackup node74 only for 'late links still to set is not complete' and node75 for the unfinished backup.

MainWindow.xaml.cs:413-414: the sizing arm says 'may be off, on disk especially'; the listing arm drops 'are short' and matches the m1 disposition text after 'What was read before the stop.'. Design doc :94-101 records the decision. No row marking changed.

cases.evidence: UnfinishedTests.StopsInTheListingMarkWhatAPendingCheckCouldChange: Stop at every AfterFolder (last included), guarded calls 1-6 (EmptyStores >= 2 asserted), every call of the multi-buffer 'wide' folder (asserted more than 4 calls), and Cancel at 10 entries of a commit, with the committed folder asserted listed.

Theory part (i), workers 1 and 4, ProbeBatch 8: Cancel from the ProbeRule seam on the scan thread at k = 9, 17, 25, ... (exact boundaries) and mid-build; prober.Calls == ordinal proves pass.Run returned Cancelled before probing. My one-batch-late mutant turned both rows red.
Theory part (ii): Cancel in the Prober's Before/After hooks at 14 call numbers, workers 1 and 4; asserts a probe was made in the discarded batch and that the cutoff is that batch's first entry.

StuckStop: the Before hook blocks on an event no Cancel reaches; ProbeAbandonAfter 200 ms; with workers=1 every worker is stuck (with 4, one is); the store dump at return equals the dump after release.

Grow groups A (first name in ga, later in ga\sub), C (beside), E (ge1 vs ge2\sub), G (deep chain vs gg), in both Facts; every ancestor of a pending first name is asserted Unfinished and the charged names match the reference. 'Later name in an ancestor' cannot be built under DFS order (the ancestor's name is always met first), so the fixture has the first name in the ancestor.
Shrink groups B, D, F listed 1 MiB, true 4 KiB; floor ShrinkAboveWhileAtLeastHolds >= 1 asserted in both sweeps; AtLeast <= reference asserted for every unfinished folder.
Floors LaterNameFolderFinalFirstPending >= 1 and CorrectedFirstFolderFinal >= 1 in the sizing Theory; every final folder's rolled and AtLeast figures are compared with the reference by path.
The Prober returns error 5 for pf1\x.bin and pf2\y.bin; the references assert ProbeFailures == 2; floor RefusedCheckFolderFinal >= 1.

Synthetic scanner-order stores with CloudOnly, repeated-ID, no-ID, link and empty or unlisted subfolders, plus a 70,000-child block asserted to straddle a page; watermarks 0, Count, random. My mutation removing `ChildCount > 0` turned this Fact red; reading one page hung it on the straddle store.

Per review m5's accepted disposition the 200 ms comparison was replaced: NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned cancels at entry Count-3, inside a commit, and asserts the folder reads listed with its checked-kind files pending. The stuck-worker dumps carry the 'nothing changes' half.

AScanThatRunsToTheEndMarksNothing: StopTree run to the end, SweepTree with 5 files deleted from AfterFolder (VanishedBeforeProbe == 5 asserted), and a folders-only tree with Probes == 0; nothing is pending or unfinished, AtLeast == rolled, and StoppedInSizeChecks is false.
The git diff over tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests is empty (exit 0); the full suite including the counting-rule and last-access classes passed 1096/1096 under TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp in my run.

UnfinishedBudgetTests rows false and true (4.88M entries; watermark 0, and 97% with corrections applied) read every entry's Unfinished and AtLeast, assert 0 bytes allocated, < 1 MiB retained and peak < 800 MiB, and compare with a Parent walk. Green in my run.

I ran WindowCases -Case L-004: hook acted at sized=0 of 60,000, Cancelled, 30 rows with reading, notRead and stoppedPartway all 0, header == $StoppedSizingHeader and != $StoppedListHeader; then L-001 PASSED with the new listing string.

drift: StopTree has an eighth group H whose LATER name is the stale one (UnfinishedTests.cs:414). Seven first names are made stale, so Reference.Take's void floor is ProbeCorrections >= 7, not the design's '>= 8'. Not declared; harmless, and it adds a shape: a stale later name charges nothing.

The listing sweep stops through Scans.RunCancellingAt with its own Options() (ContainerLayerStorePath ""), not through NotListedTests.StopAt as the design named (lesson #511). StopTree has no layer store, and Baseline and the stops use the same options, so the call numbers line up. Not declared.

NothingChangesOnceTheScanHasReturned's doc says 'every probe worker stuck', but StuckStop blocks one probe call, so in the 4-worker row three workers are free. The workers=1 row is the every-worker shape. The comment overstates the 4-worker row.

SizeCheckPending, Unfinished and AtLeast have no caller in src outside ScanStore; App wiring is filed to SC-393, as the design says, the same state as SL-111's NotListedAtOrBelow. Recorded so the next reader does not read the green suite as App coverage.
